name: unary-seed-adapter
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.candidate-seed.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; bun test research/bapa/candidate-seed.test.ts research/bapa/candidate-seed-public.test.ts research/bapa/proof-worker.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; printf '%s\n' 'fix(bapa): restate unary map candidates over sized sorts' > "$OUT/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/commit-message.txt" > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1
